# Roadmap

Where Hyperspace Vault is heading. This page is generated from the project's private work registry: one line per item the owner has chosen to make public. It is a direction signal, not a promise of dates. Ideas and bug reports are welcome through [Issues](../../issues/new/choose).

<!-- generated by specification_documents/planning/foundation/tools/registry.mjs roadmap; do not hand-edit -->

## In the works

- Price history back to 2024 for every printing. *(in progress)*

## Planned

- See every printing of a card across all sets in one place.
- Filter by all selected traits or any of them, your choice.
- A real site icon and a picture when you share a link.
- Shareable infographic reports of your collection.
- A wanted list you can share, so friends can see which cards you are hunting.
- Binders: split your copies across named lists and see what is left in storage.
- Track cards you have lent out, and mark surplus copies for trade.
- Share a binder or your trade pile with a link.
- Set your own playset size (3, 4, 6...) and completion follows it.
- Add a whole set at once: pick a finish and a quantity.
- Intro Battle: Hoth duplicate printings count toward one playset.
- Choose Cardmarket or TCGplayer as your price source.
- Import your HoloScan collection cleanly.
- Per-printing playset pips in the desktop hover card.
